The '''Wodan system''' was located in the [[Rifle Worlds]], an area of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]] in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It was connected by the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Great Rim Route]] to the [[Divora system/Legends|Divora]] and [[Relephon system/Legends|Relephon systems]] and by another [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route linked it to the [[Algnadesh system/Legends|Algnadesh system]].<ref name="TEA" /> The Wodan [[Star system/Legends|system]] was home to the organisms known as [[Wodanian wood-sprite]]s.<ref name="SW9" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Wodan system was introduced in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-9.<ref name="TEA" />
